title: Finite mathematical interfaces in iPRA
status_convention: A defined Prop target is not a proved theorem. Human proof and checked host semantics do not automatically imply an actual embedded Prf PRAAx derivation.

claims.statement: Finite observations, local iPRA contracts, bounded invariants and permitted recursion compose to give an internal result.
claims.human_proof: Detailed Booleanization and restricted proof-transformation argument.
claims.implementation: Specified numerical encodings, bounded Boolean predicates, contracts, resource rules.
claims.limits: Only the explicitly allowed constructions with proved local contracts, invariant initialization/preservation, and postcondition. No semantic reflection.

claims.statement: Every finite PTm term compiles to an equivalent PR symbol.
claims.human_proof: Structural proof from projection/composition axioms and equality rules.
claims.lean_status: Checked object proofs: symbol_correct and transport_equation.
claims.limits: Host syntax induction constructs an object proof; not an internal universal evaluator.

claims.statement: Fixed D,b,F compile to a PR 2 symbol with changing-parameter recurrence.
claims.human_proof: Backward horizon coherence and forward replay developed explicitly; credits prior semantic construction.
claims.lean_status: PR syntax, denote_compiled, compiled_zero and compiled_succ checked.
claims.limits: Semantic recurrence checked; full object recurrence still pending.

claims.statement: Generic backward-pass zero and successor equations have actual iPRA proofs.
claims.limits: Seven remaining object targets for the full construction are defined in ObjectTargets.lean.

claims.statement: A controlled lexicographic d-tuple chain starting s has length at most F_d(x,s)-s.
claims.human_proof: Full monotonicity, bounded block decomposition, chain bound, and sharpness argument.
claims.lean_status: Explicit PR syntax and denotation checked; chain and growth correctness remain target propositions.
claims.limits: d fixed externally; h primitive recursive and monotone with the required internal proof.

claims.statement: Fixed-dimensional PR ranking of a PR transition system yields a PR execution bound from its finite-trajectory envelope.
claims.human_proof: Full finite-simulation, invariant, running-maximum, inactivity and witness argument; worked reset example.
claims.limits: Consumes internal invariant, absorbing-state, local rank and output proofs. Fuel may be enormous.

claims.statement: No uniform primitive-recursive length bound exists for unrestricted dimension and envelope h(t)=t+1.
claims.human_proof: Full structural majorization of PR definitions and diagonal contradiction.
claims.implementation: Symbolic mathematical result; small finite diagnostics only.
claims.limits: Does not exclude better bounds for variable-rank families with extra structure.

claims.statement: Every nonzero rational polynomial has a PR complete duplicate-free rational-root scan.
claims.human_proof: Full denominator clearing, rational-root divisibility and bounded-enumeration proof; credits earlier packet.
claims.lean_status: Concrete program compiled; three correctness targets unproved.
claims.limits: Zero polynomial is unsupported; nonzero constants have empty root list.

claims.statement: A bounded c in 0..d+e makes both highest V coefficients constant nonzero.
claims.human_proof: Finite root bound and homogeneous-coefficient proof.
claims.lean_status: Concrete definitions compiled; ShearEvalTarget and CanonicalShearTarget unproved.

claims.statement: Every supplied distinct rational common-point list has length at most d*e under Good(F,G).
claims.human_proof: Permutation degree audit, adjugate evaluation, Vandermonde fibre multiplicity and coprime cancellation.
claims.implementation: Concrete determinant/shear programs; exact sharp examples.
claims.lean_status: Corresponding degree, root, fibre and cardinality targets unproved.
claims.limits: Good includes a computed nonzero resultant; no general coprimality characterization assumed.

claims.statement: A fixed PR procedure computes exactly all affine rational common points and a height/code bound on the successful domain.
claims.human_proof: Full two-level root enumeration and inverse-shear completeness argument.
claims.lean_status: Concrete definitions compiled; complete/cardinality/height targets unproved.
claims.limits: Unsupported and empty are distinct. No complete-list claim for all polynomial pairs.

claims.statement: Pointwise good auxiliaries in a bounded degree-and-coefficient-height box give a complete target list without a selector.
claims.human_proof: Finite box coverage, exhaustive intersection union, PR filtering and maxima.
claims.lean_status: Concrete box/envelope definitions compiled; count, coverage, complete/cardinality/height targets unproved.
claims.limits: Coverage and coefficient-height envelope must be supplied and proved. Algorithm does not establish those hypotheses.

claims.statement: Pointwise finite bounded witnesses and complete finite certificate lists compose to a complete filtered target list.
claims.human_proof: Full soundness, completeness and bounded-loop proof.
claims.implementation: Abstract finite algorithm specified in the report.
claims.limits: Requires bounded candidate envelope and PR predicates/finite witness lists.

claims.statement: Uniform bound one on distinct satisfying lists does not yield a uniform computable complete list or height bound.
claims.human_proof: First-halting-time predicate and contradiction with undecidability; affine auxiliary realization.
claims.implementation: Boundary theorem; no unbounded enumeration program supplied.
claims.limits: Degree-only tuple-local auxiliary covers give a cardinality bound, not a uniform coefficient envelope.

not_claimed: A proof audit of all 60 repository packets
A complete general verified iPRA embedding compiler
Completed object-iPRA proofs of the lexicographic and elimination extensions
General Siegel, Faltings, effective Roth, Mordell-Weil or prime-distribution theorems in iPRA
Independence of the unresolved named mathematical theorems from iPRA
Historical priority for standard termination or elimination ingredients
